verdicts.reason: A shrinks the can, the hero product, to a small afterthought pushed into the right third, so the text block wins on visual weight. Its oversized pill CTA and the subtitle running wide to the left edge make the left side feel cramped, while the dark panel's edge cuts awkwardly across the top beside the logo. B gives the can real presence on the left and reads in a sensible left-to-right banner order. Its flaws are a subtitle jammed about 20px from the right edge, a logo that is off-axis from the centred text column, and a background panel that is visibly cropped at the top-right.
